headline: Kyriakos Mitsotakis announces VAT cut on sanitary towels, tampons and incontinence pads
summary: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis announced a reduction of VAT from 24% to 13% for sanitary towels, tampons and incontinence pads. The measure will apply from a date later in the year.
why: VAT changes alter consumer prices and retail demand for affected goods. Fiscal measures of this kind affect government revenue and budget planning.
